from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of financial data extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company reported on")
    monetary_funds: float = Field(description="The value of monetary funds (货币资金)")
    accounts_receivable: float = Field(description="The value of accounts receivable (应收账款)")
    inventory: float = Field(description="The value of inventory (存货)")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the report, e.g., 2025-03-31")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all financial records extracted from the document collection."""
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
